name: Instagram
summary: Disconnect cross-site tracking, lock down discoverability, and stop contact syncing.

settings.name: Off-Meta Activity
settings.impact: Meta's tracking pixels follow you across millions of websites even when you're not on Instagram. Disconnecting stops that data from feeding your ad profile.
settings.source: Consumer Reports: 'Instagram Privacy Settings You Should Change Right Now'

settings.name: Two-Factor Authentication
settings.impact: SMS-based 2FA is vulnerable to SIM-swapping. An authenticator app generates codes locally and cannot be intercepted by a carrier hack.
settings.source: Consumer Reports; Tom's Guide '5 steps to safer social media'

settings.name: Location Access
settings.impact: Instagram uses location data for ad targeting across the Meta ecosystem. Denying at the OS level prevents this entirely — location is not required for core features.
settings.source: Consumer Reports: 'Instagram Privacy Settings You Should Change Right Now'

settings.name: Account Privacy
settings.impact: Public accounts let data brokers and scrapers harvest your photos, stories, and captions. A private account requires you to approve each follower.
settings.source: Consumer Reports; NJCCIC Instagram Security Guide

settings.name: Contact Syncing
settings.impact: Instagram uses your address book to build social graphs and recommend your profile to contacts' contacts — including people you may not want to be findable by.
